task_specification.objective: Make the dense-run contract recapture-ready while preserving the authored cemetery, gameplay causality, and presentation contracts, so the host can perform renderer-honest native qualification when an eligible renderer is available.

diagnosis.root_cause: The dense-run gate is blocked by renderer qualification, not an identified gameplay scalability defect: prior evidence shows the deterministic dense profile and reset instrumentation are present, but the only available llvmpipe/software renderer is correctly rejected and native 1920x1080 three-cycle evidence cannot be collected in this environment.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, or surgically modify the preserved authored cemetery package or retained gameplay components.
Do not force a native qualification pass, reinterpret software-renderer evidence, or fabricate performance measurements.

If the candidate-side dense contract is already complete and no lifecycle regression is reproduced, limit changes to the smallest recapture-enabling instrumentation and leave ordinary gameplay behavior unchanged.
Do not expand into deferred audio, camera, or unrelated backlog work.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior dense-profile treatments: audit the qualification boundary and lifecycle reset invariants, add only missing aggregate/readiness telemetry needed for direct host recapture, and avoid renderer-specific tuning or transform changes.

code: Run static/script checks and native/host boot validation; inspect modified dense aggregation and reset paths for bounded containers, exactly-once signal/timer cleanup, and absence of parse or resource-load errors.
Verify the renderer gate cannot be bypassed and that telemetry distinguishes native, software-rejected, and pending states without fabricating qualification.
runtime: Host/GameLoop Runtime recaptures the deterministic dense protocol at the acceptance resolution, including three complete reset cycles, runtime state/digest, logs, screenshots, and performance receipts; verify frame-time/subsystem samples, active-count high-water marks, and reset-isolation evidence.
Run native renderer qualification when available. If the environment remains llvmpipe/software, retain rejected_software_renderer as insufficient external evidence and keep the gate open.
visual: Tester samples dense gameplay and retry to confirm the authored cemetery remains coherent, the central building/landmarks and perimeter remain visible during ordinary movement, no pooled stale effects or hidden colliders appear, and upgrade-card silhouettes, compact stats, truthful deltas, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus remain readable.

done_when: The authoritative dense profile records bounded frame-time distribution and subsystem samples, active enemy/projectile/pickup/effect/light/audio counts, pool high-water marks, orphan/error counts, and lifecycle deltas across three complete prepare/advance/reset cycles; repeated cycles show no structural growth or stale callbacks, timers, pause state, input ownership, pooled state, or attack ledগر.

Renderer identity and hardware eligibility are captured before sampling, software sessions remain explicitly rejected_software_renderer, unknown sessions remain pending_native_renderer, and no receipt can report native qualification without eligible native-renderer evidence at 1920x1080.

Dense combat remains playable and readable with the representative 25-40 enemy range, all weapon families, pickups, UI, animation, VFX, lights, audio, and boss behavior; automatic attacks, damage causality, XP/reward flow, movement, and retry continue to function during the profile.

Upgrade choices retain the required authored visual hierarchy: recognizable weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no NEW or LOCKED placeholder in the CURRENT column, restrained copy, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states.

The arena keeps a larger traversable scale with coherent external world depth beyond the boundary; every central building or landmark has aligned collision and remains visible without disappearance or occlusion drift during ordinary movement and movement replay around both sides and the full perimeter.
Tester can directly rerun the same dense protocol, inspect source and runtime receipts, and distinguish candidate readiness from the unavailable external native collector.
tasks.instructions: Own the release-convergence dense performance surface. Inspect scripts/gameplay/dense_profile.gd and the RunController dense prepare/advance/reset and cycle aggregation paths. Because the latest finding is an external renderer-collector limitation after two prior treatments, do not retune transforms or repeatedly rewrite the existing scheduler; first verify the current contract and lifecycle invariants, then add only missing percentile/distribution summaries, high-water/leak deltas, or provenance fields that make host recapture directly auditable. Ensure pooling/reuse and teardown reset connections, timers, pause/input ownership, attack ledgers, and active counts exactly once. Preserve the intact cemetery package and ordinary combat behavior. As a same-loop contract guard, repair only if source/runtime inspection exposes a regression in the authored upgrade-card hierarchy or arena spatial integrity: keep silhouettes/stat icons/truthful current-to-new deltas and full input focus states, and keep larger traversable scale, external world depth, central building/landmark collision, no disappearance/occlusion, and boundary/perimeter behavior under ordinary movement. Never convert llvmpipe evidence into a native pass.
